tools.name: mood_analyzer
tools.description: Analyze user text sentiment. Returns: {mood: 'positive'|'neutral'|'negative', polarity: -1..1, trace_id: string, confidence: 0..1}

text.description: Journal or chat text to analyze (max 10000 chars)

examples.text: I had a great day at the beach!
The meeting was frustrating and unproductive.

error_handling.error_response: Returns {error: string, code: string, suggestion: string}

tools.name: music_recommender
tools.description: Generate playlist seeds based on mood analysis. Returns: {seeds: string[], genres: string[], trace_id: string}

mood.description: Mood label from mood_analyzer tool output. Must be one of: positive, neutral, negative

limit.description: Maximum number of seeds to return (default: 10)

error_handling.error_response: Returns {error: string, code: string, suggestion: string}

configuration.note: REPLACE <your-project> in all URLs with your actual Vercel project name.
configuration.authentication: Add Authorization header if your API requires it: "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
